description: Capabilities for the main window. core:default is Tauri's own baseline (window handle, no filesystem/dialog/shell access). dialog:default and fs:default are Phase 2's native sink (app/src/tauri-sink.js): the save dialog picks a destination, and Tauri's documented runtime-scope extension -- a path returned by the dialog plugin's own picker is usable by the fs plugin even though fs:default's own scope grants nothing on its own -- is what lets plugin-fs write there without this file naming every drive a user might save to.
